authorization: User selected anyone with separate temporary workspaces at https://allow.alloy4.fun on a separate Windows10 21H2 IoT Enterprise machine with WSL2 Ubuntu24.04. Implement isolated anonymous enrollment, a target transfer package and scoped acceptance. Existing private package is not public-ready. Remote credentials are never repository/config/log inputs.

architecture.mode: Closed PRIVATE default or ANONYMOUS configuration; unknown modes fail startup. One owned Spring/SQL installation, shared global sandbox budget, independent per-workspace service objects and trusted immutable scope. Never multiply full JVM/PostgreSQL installations per visitor. PRIVATE retains existing token/workspace behavior.
architecture.scope: Server allocates fresh principal/workspace/logical-launch UUIDs and random256-bit bearer; only token digest retained in Java registry. No client-selected tenant, workspace, role or filesystem path. Each resolved session owns immutable scoped DocumentGateway, DocumentMutations pending/recovery maps and DocumentQueries analyses. Jobs explicitly bind immutable owner on submit/get/cancel. No mutable global scope or implicit ThreadLocal authority. Existing private service objects are unreachable through anonymous routing.
architecture.sql: Extend existing documents PostgreSQL/RLS store and exact receipt/history/recovery semantics. Closed Java-to-Python frame carries only trusted allocated scope. Public lifecycle registry marks only newly allocated anonymous scopes, expiry and incarnation; private workspace identity remains untouched. Every SQL statement including migration, lifecycle, cleanup and testing uses canonical sql_connections/SQLeanParser route. App-role DELETE remains forbidden; closed lifecycle cleanup uses existing trusted admin proxy connection and explicit scope plus registry checks, never arbitrary SQL or browser paths. No privileged cleanup endpoint is public.
architecture.corpus: Public profile disables corpus metadata/search/import/training routes and hides private library UI. No visitor model enters embeddings/training. Existing anonymous slot canonicalization remains unchanged for normal workers. Public corpus publication remains separate from this deployment.

session_protocol.bootstrap: Public GET /api/public/config returns nonsecret mode/limits only. POST /api/public/workspaces accepts exactly {} with application/json, at most1KiB, exact configured Host and exactly one configured HTTPS Origin, no bearer/cookie authority, no query or alias. No CORS wildcard. Returns token only once with no-store over configured HTTPS. Static assets remain public; every workspace/document/job API requires exactly one resolved unexpired bearer. Private launch token never grants anonymous access.
session_protocol.retention: Four sessions maximum counting provisioning, active, retiring and quarantined slots. Absolute lifetime30minutes from reservation; no sliding refresh. New session creation has global bucket capacity4, refill1/minute; no waiting queue or eviction of another visitor. In-flight creation failure cannot silently release capacity while SQL outcome is unknown. Restart revokes all capabilities; startup reconciles registered temporary scopes before accepting new enrollment. Reuse neither scope UUIDs nor credentials.
session_protocol.browser: Explicit Start temporary workspace, lifetime/deletion explanation and capacity response. Store capability in this tab's sessionStorage plus memory for reload; never in URL/query/localStorage/telemetry. Clear on expiration/end. Do not silently replace an expired workspace. Keep unsaved in-memory draft visible for copying/export, with server actions disabled, and allow explicit new session. PRIVATE fragment flow remains compatible.
session_protocol.expiry: Server monotonic lifetime governs in-process access and publication, persisted UTC expiry labels cleanup after restart. Expiration/revocation rejects new requests and all results/publication at or after deadline. Accepted in-flight operations may finish internally during draining but cannot publish success after expiry. Cancel owned solver jobs; retain slot until active request owners, queued/start races and actual child reaping are resolved. Inaccessible data is purged only after drain and SQL-context cleanup certainty; uncertain cleanup quarantines capacity. Logical deletion is not secure erasure of WAL, backups or storage media.
session_protocol.recovery: A persistent lifecycle registry is created before workspace initialization and records fresh public-only scopes. On restart under exclusive installation/cgroup ownership, deny requests until old process ownership and SQL contexts are reconciled and temporary scopes deleted or quarantined. Never reset private identity, locks or ownership journals. Keep uncertain lifecycle work visible and capacity-consuming instead of claiming deletion.

bounds.workspace: At most3 documents,128 revisions,256 receipts and16MiB accounted stored bytes INCLUDING reservations per workspace. Retain existing stricter per-request/source/artifact limits. Enforce smaller budgets in the trusted SQL store before admission, not only frontend. Four slots imply at most64MiB accounted workspace data, excluding bounded PostgreSQL/WAL overhead and temporary workers.
bounds.execution: Existing one global Java worker permit and global SQL validation context lane remain singletons. At most one outstanding expensive operation per workspace, one solver running globally and existing queue bound4; expired queued jobs cannot start. Bound retained jobs/results and pending maps within session quotas. Global API admission caps concurrent guarded requests at8 and per-session at2; a finite token bucket limits guarded API requests, while enrollment has its own bucket. No trusted client identity from arbitrary forwarded headers; source-IP rate limiting is not claimed without verified ingress.
bounds.deployment: Initial WSL ceiling5GiB/4processors/swap0 and Linux service MemoryHigh3G/MemoryMax4G/TasksMax512, leaving headroom if machine total is8GiB. Resource fit and throughput remain target measurements; backpressure is expected. Bounded anonymous enrollment cannot guarantee availability against distributed or repeated session occupation.

wsl_iis.target: Windows10 21H2 IoT Enterprise, WSL2 Ubuntu24.04, https://allow.alloy4.fun. Verify actual Windows/WSL build, distro name, systemd/cgroups, Java17 and bwrap namespace behavior. WSL mirrored networking is not assumed on Windows10.
wsl_iis.route: IIS HTTPS at configured host forwards only to Windows127.0.0.1:18081. Prefer verified WSL2 NAT localhost forwarding to Linux127.0.0.1:18081 on same physical host, with backend exact Host127.0.0.1:18081 and Originhttps://allow.alloy4.fun. Backend/SQL ports must not be externally reachable. No0.0.0.0 backend or public portproxy fallback. If loopback mapping cannot be demonstrated, stop target acceptance and retain existing SSH architecture as a separately configured fallback.
wsl_iis.lifecycle: Use dedicated WSL service account and Linux filesystem /opt/allow, not /mnt/c. A reviewed Windows task runs under the WSL distribution-owning account, keeps an explicit wsl.exe invocation alive and supervises service availability with bounded restart/backoff; systemd alone is not assumed to keep WSL alive. Do not modify other distributions, global WSL configuration, existing tasks/sites or existing data silently. Stage exact configs and target preflight/commands; install startup task only against verified target settings.
wsl_iis.exposure: Retain stopped IIS staging and restrictive ingress until isolation, native WSL/IIS route and restart acceptance pass. Preserve certificate/host/origin/logging checks. DNS currently resolves through an intermediary; its presence grants no trusted headers or origin bypass. Native login/target capability may be unavailable; report this accurately and supply transfer artifacts rather than claim remote work.

proof_and_review.first: Two GPT-6.1 Terra, two GPT-6.1 Sol and two GPT-6 Astra review the exact frozen contract. Compile a Lean4 supplement twice before production edits, with standard axioms only and concrete positive witnesses.
proof_and_review.model: Finite claims for capability-to-scope isolation, owner-bound document/job/receipt visibility, expiry and publication fence, bounded reservations and non-eviction, draining/quarantine before reuse, private/corpus mode separation, parser-only SQL route, no default public exposure, and WSL prerequisites distinct from target acceptance.
proof_and_review.limits: These policies do not prove cryptography, JVM/Python/SQL/IIS implementation correspondence, OS scheduling, race freedom, secure deletion, systemd/WSL behavior, practical capacity, licensing or universal safety. Retain explicit implementation/runtime obligations and all unresolved gates.

acceptance: Two simultaneous sessions: cross-document/history/revision/receipt/ID-inventory/job/result/cancel substitution denied with no leakage; same idempotency key across scopes independent; public private-token and corpus routes denied.

Concurrent enrollment at cap, rate/admission exhaustion, quota reservations, unknown initialization outcomes, no token logs/URLs; bounded memory/disk/pending retention and no eviction of active visitors.

Expiry while SQL/worker/queued job executes; no success published after deadline, actual child reap distinguished from CANCELLED display, cleanup failure retains quarantine and stale capability never revives.

Restart revokes sessions and reconciles only registered temporary scopes; private workspace control data survives; cleanup traverses all dependent rows atomically through SQLeanParser and refuses uncertain SQL contexts.
Full frontend tests/build/style, real two-tab browser creation/save/reload/isolation/expiry and copy/export; Java/JS/TS documented callables<=30physical lines and class encapsulation.

Isolated fresh SQL/sandbox HTTP integration and packaging; no live workstation database, runtime credentials or active preview mutation. Native Windows10/WSL2/IIS loopback/TLS/reboot/outage and external domain checks remain mandatory before exposure.
